messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failure detected for rollout 'model:redwood-llm-v4' on us-west1-gpu. Error rate 18% > 10% threshold. Logs: https://internal/logs/rollout/9876 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for on-call rotation #3: jamie (oncall). Severity: P1. Please acknowledge.
jamie (oncall): acknowledged. I'm looking.
maria (sre): seeing 502s + malformed token output in live requests. Spike at 21:12 UTC on the rate dashboard.
kevin (mlops): I pulled the release metadata — weight bundle v4-2026-03-15 was deployed. Tokenizer metadata in manifest shows tokenizer_version: 2.1 but runtime expects 2.0.
elena (product-support): support already has customer reports: "responses gibberish/repeating tokens" from tenant acme-inc. Created ticket #12345.
jamie (oncall): can we isolate canary and stop routing? rollback? kill-switch?
kevin (mlops): recommend immediate feature-flag toggle to stop routing to v4 canary and fallback to v3-stable. Also abort the rollout. Run:
```
redwoodctl feature-flags unset rollout.model_v4 --env=prod --scope=canary
redwoodctl rollout abort --id=rollout-9876
```
jamie (oncall): executing now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag unset acknowledged. Traffic shifting away from canary... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria (sre): after traffic shift, error rate dropping to 2% and latency back to baseline. No new customer complaints in the last 5m.
kevin (mlops): while investigating, I noticed checksum mismatch between manifest and weight blob for v4-2026-03-15. Likely an incomplete upload or staging/production desync. That plus tokenizer_version drift = bad mapping.
kevin (mlops): mark the weightset deprecated and revoke access:
```
weightsctl mark-deprecated --id v4-2026-03-15 --reason "checksum mismatch + tokenizer mismatch"
registryctl revoke --id v4-2026-03-15
```
elena (product-support): notifying impacted customers and sending interim update: we've paused the rollout and restored traffic to v3-stable. Providing ETA for RCA.
jamie (oncall): handing off to tom (infra) for rollback verification and kevin for RCA. Oncall handover: jamie -> tom.
jamie (oncall): @tom can you validate no residual routing to v4 and terminate any stuck canary pods?
tom (infra): checking k8s. Some pods in us-west1 are in Terminating for >2m, forcing delete now. Also pruning old endpoints from the router cluster.

maria (sre): logs show tokenizer exception stack: "TokenizationError: unknown token id 0xFF at position 12" across multiple requests — consistent with tokenizer dictionary drift.
kevin (mlops): confirmed. Tokenizer mismatch produced invalid token ids, which then produced malformed decoding and downstream errors. We'll add pre-deploy validations to compare tokenizer checksums and block rollout if mismatch.

jamie (oncall): immediate mitigation complete. Downgrading severity to P2. Scheduling RCA with ML release + infra tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Action items captured:
- kevin (mlops): revoke weightset, add checksum & tokenizer validation in release pipeline.
- tom (infra): add router sanity check to ensure zero residual routes for aborted rollouts.
- maria (sre): draft incident timeline + customer impact summary.
- elena (product-support): customer comms + ticket updates.

elena (product-support): outgoing message to acme-inc: "We stopped the v4 rollout and restored v3. Root cause appears to be tokenizer/weights mismatch; full RCA and timeline to follow." :white_check_mark:
jamie (oncall): thanks team. Closing pager but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :lock:
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> P2 transition recorded. Incident owner: kevin (mlops). Follow-up meeting created: https://meet.link/incident-2123456789
